name: Haus Bettina
beschreibung: Haus Bettina is a holiday apartment in the municipality of Ladis in Tirol. The accommodation is in a quiet location, yet close to the Ladis gondola lift, which provides access to the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski area. The apartment comprises separate bedrooms, a living area, a kitchenette and a bathroom. Amenities include satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. A ski storage room and a parking space are available. In summer, the holiday apartment is an ideal starting point for hikes; in winter, for ski days. From the balcony, there is a view of the surrounding mountain landscape.
